requirement: A quickstart fill puts a neutral placeholder in a picture slot no business photo fits and goes to review, instead of failing the build

oracle.ref: PR #1644 (fix); fix evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a JA Restaurant WordPress Website Opportunities build planned 47 placements and 28 unfilled slots, then failed with QUICKSTART_PICTURE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE; the hand-off answered 409 SITE_FILL_FAILED and the site stayed the untouched template.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. On WordPress, Joomla and EmDash a slot with no fitting photo keeps its place with an uploaded, read-back placeholder, and the report lists the gap and the placeholder. Every picture missing fills every slot with placeholders; an unresolved slot still stops the fill before any upload; a resumed fill reuses verified uploads. Quickstart QA with placeholder gaps ends needs-review with reason quickstart-picture-placeholders/1, never passed and never failed.
